annotations.title: What to learn first at an HSK level

description: Get the opening vocabulary lessons of an HSK level, in the order GraphChinese teaches them, each a themed group of words with pinyin and meaning. This is a learning order, not an alphabetical word list. Use this when the user asks what words to learn first, or what to start with at HSK 1 to 5. Do not use it to look up one word (use lookup_word).
name: get_study_order
